notes: Hydrocolloid + acrylic adhesive. No common allergens or PFAS; mild irritation possible from adhesive but not a priority allergen.
Chemical sunscreen with octocrylene, homosalate (EWG flags but not on our priority KB). Some other_concerns possible. NOT PFAS-positive (no fluorinated UV filters).

PTFE coating is a polyfluorinated polymer. Should match PFAS KB by name 'PTFE' or 'Polytetrafluoroethylene'. Some PFAS regulators classify the polymer itself differently — accept either inclusion or other_concerns.
Enameled cast iron — no PFAS, no common allergens. Negative control.
Salicylic acid is an exfoliant — possible irritant, not in our priority allergen KB. Tetrasodium EDTA + butylene glycol may show as other_concerns.
